rows.actualDefect: Guidance asks whether oath before authorized officer/notary is required although delivered CR-65 page 8 expressly requires it. C-10 page 1 alternate MUNICIPALITY OF field classified REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and unconditionally demanded although State of Alabama is selected. CR-65 page 3 off checkbox appearance visibly erases parts of printed letters in expired in both original canonical and boundary images. Inverted source-widget rectangle requires normalization before flattening. Previous-expungement county/case required unconditionally although source limits them to the previous-application YES branch. Source-required CR-65 p5 attachment, p6 prior-application selection and pro-se election remain unselected without the participant handback supplied in the other three family guides. Fee-waiver guide says complete affidavit but does not hand back its unselected expungement fee request; the other two printed requests concern counsel and ignition interlock fees. Felony DWOP already supplies the specific conditional expungement election.
rows.correction: Bound CR-65 form instructions now require signing under oath before an official authorized to administer oaths or a notary; the State/circuit-court branch makes the municipality alternate not applicable; unknown CR-65 attachment, prior-application, representation, and C-10 hardship elections remain blank and are handed back with their conditions. Where the source checkbox rectangle occluded printed text, the existing ISO rectangle normalizer now runs before flattening.
